prompt: Write the body (about 180 words) of a demand letter from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer before a lawsuit. Use the exact placeholders [CLIENT_NAME] for the client, [LOSS_DATE] for the accident date and [DEMAND_AMOUNT] for the money demanded. Say an expert review supports a permanent injury and give the insurer 30 days to pay. No other names or dates.
text:
Dear Claims Representative:

This office represents [CLIENT_NAME] in connection with injuries sustained in the motor vehicle collision that occurred on [LOSS_DATE]. The facts of the collision, as documented in the police report and the statements gathered to date, establish that your insured was solely responsible for the crash. Our client was stopped lawfully at the time of impact and had no reasonable opportunity to avoid it.

Our client sought prompt medical care following the collision and has since undergone extensive treatment. A detailed review by a qualified medical expert has concluded that our client sustained a permanent injury as a direct result of this collision. The treatment records, imaging, and expert opinion all link the injury to the accident, and we anticipate no credible basis for disputing causation.

Our client has suffered substantial medical expenses, lost income, diminished enjoyment of life, and ongoing pain that will persist into the future. Considering these losses, our client will accept the sum of [DEMAND_AMOUNT] in full settlement of all claims arising from this collision.

This demand remains open for 30 days from the date of this letter. If payment is not received within that period, we will file suit without further notice and seek all damages available under the law. We invite you to contact this office promptly to discuss resolution.

Sincerely,

Attorney for [CLIENT_NAME]
